newsitem.title: USA: Kmart August same-store sales rise 1.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kmart August same-store sales rise 1.0 pct.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Thursday its same-store sales rose one percent in August.
The discount store retailer said same-store sales at its U.S. general merchandise stores were up 1.4 percent during August.
Same-store sales for all Kmart general merchandise stores, which includes U.S. and international Kmart outlets, rose 1.2 percent in August, the company said.

Total sales from consolidated operations, which includes building supply retail chain Builders Square and international stores, were $2.46 billion in August, down from $2.53 billion during the same period last year.
Sales from consolidated operations for the 30 weeks ended August 28 fell $18.35 billion, down from $18.41 billion for the same period last year.
On a comparable-store basis, U.S. Kmart general merchandise stores rose 2.7 percent during the 30 weeks, Kmart said.
